title: 第76章 你再不回信息，我就报警了
content_zh:
第76章 你再不回信息，我就报警了-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

上一章

存书签

下一章

回到家，顾承安破天荒没有自己动手打扫。

他给物业打了个电话，叫了个保洁阿姨上门，大半个月没住人，灰尘不少，他现在实在不想亲自动手。

保洁阿姨干活利索，一个小时就搞定了，顾承安付了钱送走人，然后往沙发上一躺。

掏出手机。

解锁，点开警务通APP，进入国安板块。

他点进权限说明页面，逐条看了起来。

【D级权限说明】

【一、信息查询

完全继承E级公民基础脱敏信息查询权限。

可免审批调取完整户籍底档、家庭成员关联档案、名下房产车辆、工商注册备案全量信息。

自主权限开放长期出行轨迹、酒店入住、票务记录、全量通讯账单、实名网络账号备案查询。

可调阅重点管控人员库、涉稳涉恐关注台账、过往已结案脱敏卷宗。

银行流水、实时定位、深度加密后台数据，仍需提交申请经上级审批后方可临时授权。

备注：皆有操作记录，有专人定期核查，违规必究！

顾承安看到最后那行加粗的红字，挑了挑眉。

意思很明确——刀给你了，但别乱砍。砍了谁，砍了几刀，都有人盯着。

继续往下翻。

【二、通讯系统】

这个没变化，跳过。

【三、应急模块】

保留E级一键求援、同步安全屋及支援单位基础功能。

新增：一键求援优先级提升，可优先调度就近专职特勤支援力量，高于普通外勤响应顺位。

可自主报备后临时调用辖区安全屋资源，无需逐级审批。

很好理解，就是字面意思。

【四、专项授权】

拥有线索初核建档权限，可对可疑人员、敏感线索独立梳理归档，提交上级研判。

具备对内基层单位简易内部协查提请权，可直接对接公安、交通等端口调取常规线索资料。

可阅览内部三级涉密及以下区域研判简报、风险动态资料。

顾承安把手机放下，盯着天花板。

E级的时候，很多查询需要申请得到授权后才行，现在可以自主查询了。

更关键的是第四条。

线索初核建档权。

When he got home, Gu Chengan, for the first time, did not clean up by himself.

He called the property management company and asked a cleaning lady to come to the house. It had been unoccupied for more than half a month and there was a lot of dust. He really didn't want to do it himself now.

The cleaning aunt worked quickly and finished it in an hour. Gu Chengan paid the money and sent the person away, then lay down on the sofa.

Take out your phone.

Unlock it, click on the Police Pass APP and enter the national security section.

He clicked on the permission description page and read it one by one.

[D-level permission description]

[1. Information inquiry

Fully inherit the basic desensitized information query permissions of E-class citizens.

You can retrieve complete household registration files, family member related files, real estate and vehicles under your name, and full industrial and commercial registration information without approval.

Autonomous access to long-term travel trajectories, hotel check-in, ticket records, full communication bills, and real-name online account registration inquiries.

You can access the database of key management and control personnel, the ledger of concerns related to stability and terrorism, and desensitized files of past closed cases.

For bank flow, real-time positioning, and deeply encrypted backend data, applications still need to be submitted for approval by superiors before temporary authorization can be granted.

Remarks: All operations are recorded and regularly checked by dedicated personnel. Violations will be punished!

Gu Chengan raised his eyebrows when he saw the bold red letter at the end.

The meaning is clear - I’ve given you the knife, but don’t chop randomly.No matter who you cut or how many times you cut, everyone was watching.

Continue scrolling down.

[2. Communication system]

This has not changed, skip it.

[3. Emergency module]

The basic functions of E-level one-click rescue, synchronization of safe houses and support units are retained.

Newly added: The priority of one-click assistance has been improved, and the nearest full-time special service support force can be dispatched first, which is higher than the order of ordinary field response.

Safe house resources in the jurisdiction can be temporarily called after independent reporting without the need for step-by-step approval.

It’s easy to understand, it’s the literal meaning.

[4. Special authorization]

It has the authority to create preliminary clues and archives, and can independently sort out and archive suspicious persons and sensitive clues, and submit them to superiors for research and judgment.

It has the right to submit requests for simple internal assistance to grass-roots units, and can directly connect to public security, transportation and other ports to retrieve routine clues and information.

You can read the internal research and judgment briefings and risk dynamic information for Level 3 and below areas.

Gu Chengan put down his phone and stared at the ceiling.

At E level, many inquiries required application and authorization, but now you can make independent inquiries.

What’s more critical is the fourth one.

Initial review and filing rights for clues.
